verdict.rationale: Persona's REST API supports pre-creating inquiries (sessions), polling inquiry/verification status, and retrieving report data via webhooks and API calls, which covers much of the 'agent operates the pipeline' story. However, there is no evidence of an MCP surface, no explicit mention of scoped/limited API credentials, and no clear API-level mechanism for an agent to trigger ad-hoc re-checks (only scheduled recurring reports via Workflows are mentioned). missing for 10: MCP server/tool surface, scoped credential/API-key model, explicit agent-triggered re-verification endpoint.
